regions.region: upper title, abstract, and two-column introduction
regions.finding: Article identity and broad method claims were checked; cited prior iodocyclizations are background literature and were not converted into experiments of this paper.

regions.region: lower-right Table 1 reaction arrow, rows 1-12, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve independent base/solvent optimization rows were extracted with 1a (0.2 mmol), I2 (6 equiv.; 1.2 mmol), solvent (2 mL), base loading, room temperature, 0.5 h, and NMR yields. Entry 7 is reconciled with Table 2 entry 1 on page 2.

unresolved: Optimization rows do not state atmosphere, workup, or purification; these details were not inferred.

regions.finding: Six iodine-loading rows were checked. Entry 1 duplicates Table 1 entry 7; entry 3 is the standard 2a experiment also reported as Table 3 entry 1 and detailed on page 4. Entries 5 and 6 preserve recovered 1a separately from product yield.

regions.region: upper-right Table 3 reaction arrow, rows 1-11, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven substrate-scope rows were checked; the standard 2a row was merged with Table 2 entry 3, the one-gram-scale row remains distinct, and the 50 min override was applied only to 2e.

The 2k and 2l cyclizations were extracted as separate scope experiments with isolated yields and Z/E ratios. The subsequent 2l kinetic-resolution arrow was extracted separately and not merged into the preceding cyclization.

unresolved: Many table rows omit atmosphere and workup; complex substituted structures and stereochemistry remain machine-unverified.

regions.finding: The two iodonium pathways and Z/E rationale were classified as a proposed mechanism, not reported batch experiments or isolated intermediates.

Two Suzuki-Miyaura couplings (products 3 and 4) and one Sonogashira coupling (product 5) were extracted as three distinct experiments with arrow-specific reagent loadings, temperatures, times, and yields.

regions.region: lower discussion, conclusions, and General Information opening
regions.finding: Narrative corroborates Scheme 1 stereoselectivity and Scheme 3 transformations. Instrument and solvent-drying information was not duplicated as reaction experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 2 contains generic R groups and proposed intermediates only; complete structures cannot be assigned from the generic drawing.

regions.finding: Exact charges, 5 min base pre-stir, 0.5 h reaction, thiosulfate quench, extraction, drying, chromatography, product mass, and 74% isolated yield were merged into the standard Table 2 entry 3/Table 3 entry 1 record.
The 5.5 mmol scale experiment was retained as a distinct batch with its 10 min pre-stir, exact workup, 1.3207 g product, and 78% isolated yield.

regions.region: lower-left and right-column 2b-2f procedures plus beginning of 2g
regions.finding: Exact masses, mmol, THF volume, product masses, isolated yields, and chromatography eluents for 2b-2f were merged into Table 3 entries 3-7. The 2g paragraph begins here and is linked across page 5.

unresolved: The abbreviated 2b-2g procedures do not restate atmosphere or workup; these were not borrowed from the typical procedure.

regions.finding: Cross-page 2g and the 2h-2j batches were extracted with exact charges, product masses, isolated yields, and stated chromatography eluents.
The two stereoisomeric product mixtures were linked to Scheme 1 and preserve 86% isolated yields plus Z/E 87:13 and 85:15, respectively.

The Pd/Cu-catalyzed 2l resolution was extracted as a separate experiment with exact catalyst/reagent charges, three acetonitrile portions totaling 1.5 mL, 3 degrees C, 1.5 h, argon, purification, product mass, and 78% isolated yield.

regions.region: lower-right beginning of product 3 Suzuki procedure
regions.finding: Initial charges, order, argon atmosphere, and heating instruction begin here and were merged with the page-6 continuation rather than treated as another experiment.

unresolved: The kinetic resolution does not isolate or quantify the consumed E-isomer/coupling product; abbreviated scope workups remain unstated.

regions.region: top-left continuation of product 3 Suzuki procedure
regions.finding: The product 3 mass, 82% isolated yield, and chromatography eluent were merged with the page-5 procedure and Scheme 3 conditions.
Exact catalyst, base, boronic acid, 2a, solvent, product mass, 81% isolated yield, and eluent were merged with the 110 degrees C/13.5 h Scheme 3 arrow.
Exact Pd/Cu catalyst charges, triethylamine, 1-hexyne, 2a, acetonitrile portions, room-temperature 8 h reaction, argon, product mass, 84% isolated yield, and chromatography were extracted.

regions.region: lower-left SI notice and right-column acknowledgments/references
regions.finding: The article states that Supporting Information exists, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated. References are prior literature and were not imported as experiments.

unresolved: No SI was supplied; SI-only spectra and any omitted procedures remain unavailable. The product 4 paragraph does not restate atmosphere.
